name: Green Gruff | 600mg CBD Organic Hemp Oil | Peanut Butter
description:
New 100% organic product!720mg of full spectrum hemp extract (600mg of CBD)

Organic Full Spectrum Hemp

 • Each bottle of our Tinctures includes 720mg of full spectrum hemp extract containing 600mg of CBD

CO2 Processing is used to extract cannabinoids and terpenes from cannabis, and its hemp variety.

Organic Hemp Seed Oil

 • CBD can be infused with almost any type of edible oil, but most experts agree that hemp seed oil and medium-chain triglyceride (MCT) oil are the best carriers

 . • We think that hemp seed oil offers the most benefit for dogs, thanks to an awesome combination of Omega fats and antioxidants.

 • MCT oil is also a good option, but some owners have claimed it may contribute to gastrointestinal upset in dogs with sensitive stomachs.

 • CBD oils beat CBD treats and other types of carriers thanks to their ability to boost absorption into the body.

Green Gruff Tinctures can be used daily in conjunction with our supplements to increase daily intake of CBD. Our tinctures can also be used for special occurrences that may cause nervousness (fireworks, visitors, car rides). CBD can also improve hip and joint mobility greatly and assist with pain management.

Each full dropper holds 10mg of CBD oil

3/4 contains 7.5mgof CBD

1/2 contains 5mg of CBD

1/4 contains 2.5mg of CBD

Green Gruff Tinctures can be used daily in conjunction with our supplements

Organic Hemp
Easy to Digest
Simple CBD Dosage
